name: session-shepherd
description: Names each session after its topic, offers to go back to a session of the same name, labels the herdr workspace or tmux window, and recaps where each session stands after every turn.

askAt.title: Ask for the session name
askAt.description: prompt: on your first message, with a suggested name. start: as soon as the session opens.

recap.title: Recap each turn
recap.description: After each turn, Haiku writes Done / Needs you / Next: shown above the prompt and in herdr's agent sidebar.
